desc: Supreme Sacrifice, by meditating quietly for five minutes the character may lose ten per cent restore life chance, and regain all life points, power points and own daily innates. Each purchase is for a once ever use.
Survival of a Legend - from Survival of a Hero, now returns at 30% from 20% of points

Secondary Resistance, if after applying a published immunity to a non published effect the character would still be rendered unconscious or dead, then by expending 18 tblp (not reduced by any means) the character may ignore the effect. This does not apply to any ability the character may use against themselves, nor against damage. e.g. this ability would not work on an effect which turned you into a toad, but would if you were turned into a dead or toad. It does not apply to Resistance to Avenging Spirit, Immunity to Dying effects, or similar "self-induced" unconsciousness.

Justice of the Kings - no single weapon blow, after all armour class, damage reductions or other defences may deliver more than 30 points of damage. Note that this does not apply to spells/miracles or "effects"

Act of Faith - This ability grants immunity to an "offensive effect" if that "effect" has no published immunity or resistance available which is not a spell/miracle/Racial Ability etc. e.g. "Turn to Toad spell, regardless of resistance" would be blocked but "Turn to Toad, UNLESS immune to involuntary shape shifting owned" would not be, since a resistance is available. May be used 3 times per day only, each use granting immunity to the specific effect for 5 minutes and must be declared within 2 seconds of suffering the effect.
